01The person behind the code

More than a line of code.

I’m Sergio Alejandro Hernández Patiño, a senior software developer with over 6 years of experience in business software, consulting and technical leadership.

I combine .NET, React and Microsoft Power Platform to connect applications, workflows and data. My applied AI work includes Copilot Studio, agents and assistants, RAG and AI Builder, with technical review of the results.

My journey connects Colombia and Spain: development at CODESA and Intelecto, development leadership at Auto Control Empresarial and Microsoft 365 solutions at DynamizaTIC. I support solutions from analysis and design through testing, deployment, documentation and support.

Your visit, your preferences.

We use a cookie to remember your choice. If you accept, we save your theme and accessibility settings in this browser. No first-party analytics or advertising.

Cookies and privacy

What we store

The at_consent cookie remembers your choice for six months. Optional settings are stored locally for the same period. You can withdraw permission here: those settings will be deleted. Controls still work during your visit if you choose necessary only. If you enable the demo’s optional AI, the browser may store model files; delete them from the demo itself. Questions are not stored. The booking calendar connects to Cal.com only when you open it; booking details are handled under that provider’s privacy policy.
